documents.title: Medical statement from family doctor
documents.text:
MEDICAL STATEMENT
Patient: Jordan Example, born 1991.
Physician: Dr. Sam Fictional, Example Family Clinic.

The patient was rear-ended in a car accident on February 3, 2026. Diagnosis: whiplash injury to the neck and lower back. The patient has pain when sitting longer than 30 minutes and when lifting.
The patient has been fully off work since February 3, 2026.
The patient has been referred to an orthopedic specialist. The estimated wait is about eight weeks.
The expected duration of inability to work is uncertain.

Sincerely,
Dr. Sam Fictional

documents.title: Letter from Example Insurance Co.
documents.text:
EXAMPLE INSURANCE CO.
Claim number: EI-2026-48213
Date: September 30, 2026

We have reviewed your claim for compensation following the accident on February 3, 2026.

We have approved coverage of treatment costs totaling $14,200.

Your claim for lost income and compensation for permanent injury is denied for now. The reason is that we have no specialist statement about permanent medical impairment.

We need a statement from an orthopedic specialist by November 30, 2026. If we do not receive it by that date, the claim will be closed.

You may appeal this decision. Information about how to appeal is enclosed.

Sincerely,
Claims Department

documents.title: Decision from the State Disability Agency: application denied
documents.text:
STATE DISABILITY AGENCY
NOTICE OF DECISION
Date: October 14, 2026

We have denied your application for disability benefits.

Reason: We find that it has not been documented that your ability to work is reduced by at least half because of illness or injury. The medical statement dated March 12, 2026 describes a diagnosis, but not which work tasks you are unable to perform.

You have the right to appeal. You have 60 days from the date you receive this notice to file an appeal.
You may ask for a copy of the documents in your case.

Sincerely,
State Disability Agency

documents.title: Appointment notice from orthopedic clinic
documents.text:
ORTHOPEDIC CLINIC
Appointment notice

You are scheduled for an appointment on November 18, 2026 at 10:30 AM.
Please bring any MRI images and a list of your medications.
If you cannot attend, you must cancel at least 48 hours before the appointment.

documents.title: Voice note: talk with the employer
documents.text: I spoke with the employer today. They said they cannot adjust the work so that Jordan can work part time. The job needs heavy lifting and long periods of standing and sitting. They have not put this in writing. I have not contacted a lawyer yet. Jordan has had no income since May, and we have not collected receipts or a summary of the lost income.
